questions_and_answers.question: The instructor said: 'ブラウン課長お願いします。… でも、今日はいらしていますね。 (Buraun-kachoo onegai shimasu. ... Demo, kyoo wa irashite imasu ne.)' What is the instructor confirming?

answers.answer: That division head Brown is in today after all
That Brown is off today
That Brown is on a business trip
That Brown has no messages

questions_and_answers.question: The instructor said: 'ホールさんお願いします。外出中ですか。 (Hooru-san onegai shimasu. Gaishutsuchuu desu ka?)' What is the instructor asking?

answers.answer: Whether Mr. Hall is out of the office
Whether Mr. Hall is on the phone
Whether Mr. Hall is in a meeting
Whether Mr. Hall has gone home

questions_and_answers.question: The instructor said: 'ホワイトさんいらっしゃいますか。今日はお戻りになりますか。 (Howaito-san irasshaimasu ka? Kyoo wa omodori ni narimasu ka?)' What does the instructor want to know?

answers.answer: Whether Mr. White will return today
Whether Mr. White is off today
Whether Mr. White speaks English
Whether Mr. White left a message

questions_and_answers.question: The instructor said: 'テーラー部長いらっしゃいますか。おことづけをお願いしたいんですが、よろしいですか。 (Teeraa-buchoo irasshaimasu ka? Okotozuke o onegai shitai n desu ga, yoroshii desu ka?)' What does the instructor want to do?

answers.answer: Leave a message for department head Taylor
Cancel an appointment with Taylor
Ask when Taylor returns
Speak to Taylor in English

questions_and_answers.question: The instructor said: 'スペンサーさんいらっしゃいますか。ちょっと急用なんですが… (Supensaa-san irasshaimasu ka? Chotto kyuuyoo na n desu ga...)' What is the instructor indicating?

answers.answer: That there is some urgent business with Mr. Spencer
That Mr. Spencer is off today
That the caller will call again later
That Mr. Spencer is in a meeting

articles.text: Directions: The instructor asks whether a person that s/he wants to talk to is in or not. The student answers that s/he is not in now. The instructor asks further questions or makes a request, based on the script below. If the student understands, s/he responds appropriately. If not, s/he says that s/he does not understand Japanese well and will get someone who speaks Japanese.

Example: Instructor: Nakamura-buchoo irasshaimasu ka? Student: Ima orimasen ga... Instructor: Aa, soo desu ka. Itsu goro omodori ni narimasu ka? Student: Sumimasen. Nihongo ga yoku wakarimasen. Nihongo ga wakaru mono to kawarimasu.
